breakpoints.note: This is the control point that admits the empty buffered token into section parsing even though no explicit `{` was seen.

This is the first scored project-side materialization of the vulnerability-relevant value: an empty string lexeme whose pointer still aliases the raw fuzz buffer. The resulting `.value == static_data + 799` is the source pointer consistent with the saved `strlen` read running to the end of the 32768-byte buffer.

The fix adds `if (!lexeme->value.len) { ... return NULL; }` immediately before this call. In the vulnerable code, `lexeme->value.len == 0` reaches `lwan_strbuf_append_str()` unchanged, which activates that helper's `strlen()` path on a non-NUL-terminated pointer.
